56: /**
57:  * VersionedIntervalTimeline is a data structure that manages objects on a specific timeline.
58:  *
59:  * It associates an {@link Interval} and a generically-typed version with the object that is being stored.
60:  *
61:  * In the event of overlapping timeline entries, timeline intervals may be chunked. The underlying data associated
62:  * with a timeline entry remains unchanged when chunking occurs.
63:  *
64:  * After loading objects via the {@link #add} method, the {@link #lookup(Interval)} method can be used to get the list
65:  * of the most recent objects (according to the version) that match the given interval. The intent is that objects
66:  * represent a certain time period and when you do a {@link #lookup(Interval)}, you are asking for all of the objects
67:  * that you need to look at in order to get a correct answer about that time period.
68:  *
69:  * The {@link #findFullyOvershadowed} method returns a list of objects that will never be returned by a call to {@link
70:  * #lookup} because they are overshadowed by some other object. This can be used in conjunction with the {@link #add}
71:  * and {@link #remove} methods to achieve "atomic" updates. First add new items, then check if those items caused
72:  * anything to be overshadowed, if so, remove the overshadowed elements and you have effectively updated your data set
73:  * without any user impact.
74:  */

249:   public void addAll(
250:       final Iterator<PartitionChunkEntry<VersionType, ObjectType>> objects
251:   )
252:   {
253:     lock.writeLock().lock();
254: 
255:     try {
256:       bindAddBatch();
257:       final IdentityHashMap<TimelineEntry, Interval> allEntries = new IdentityHashMap<>();
258: 
259:       while (objects.hasNext()) {
260:         PartitionChunkEntry<VersionType, ObjectType> chunkEntry = objects.next();
261:         PartitionChunk<ObjectType> object = chunkEntry.getChunk();
262:         Interval interval = chunkEntry.getInterval();
263:         VersionType version = chunkEntry.getVersion();
264:         Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> exists = allTimelineEntries.get(interval);
265:         TimelineEntry entry;
266: 
267:         if (exists == null) {
268:           entry = new TimelineEntry(interval, version, new PartitionHolder<>(object));
269:           TreeMap<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry = new TreeMap<>(versionComparator);
270:           versionEntry.put(version, entry);
271:           allTimelineEntries.put(interval, versionEntry);
272:           numObjects.incrementAndGet();
273:         } else {
274:           entry = exists.get(version);
275: 
276:           if (entry == null) {
277:             entry = new TimelineEntry(interval, version, new PartitionHolder<>(object));
278:             exists.put(version, entry);
279:             numObjects.incrementAndGet();
280:           } else {
281:             PartitionHolder<ObjectType> partitionHolder = entry.getPartitionHolder();
282:             if (partitionHolder.add(object)) {

285:           }
286:         }

288:         allEntries.put(entry, interval);

299:         }

303:       }
304:       finishAddBatch();

314:     lock.writeLock().lock();
315:     try {
316:       Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntries = allTimelineEntries.get(interval);

496:       @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
497:       Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntryCopy = (TreeMap) versionEntry.clone();

499:     });

501:     for (TimelineEntry entry : completePartitionsTimeline.values()) {

503:           entry.getTrueInterval(),
504:           (Interval interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry) -> {

508:       );
509:     }

511:     for (TimelineEntry entry : incompletePartitionsTimeline.values()) {

513:           entry.getTrueInterval(),
514:           (Interval interval, Map<VersionType, TimelineEntry> versionEntry) -> {

523:   public boolean isOvershadowed(Interval interval, VersionType version, ObjectType object)
524:   {
525:     lock.readLock().lock();
526:     try {
527:       bindOvershadowCheck(interval, version);
528:       TimelineEntry entry = completePartitionsTimeline.get(interval);
529:       if (entry != null) {
530:         final int majorVersionCompare = versionComparator.compare(version, entry.getVersion());
531:         if (majorVersionCompare == 0) {
532:           for (PartitionChunk<ObjectType> chunk : entry.partitionHolder) {
533:             if (chunk.getObject().overshadows(object)) {
534:               return true;
535:             }
536:           }
537:           return false;
538:         } else {
539:           return majorVersionCompare < 0;
540:         }
541:       }
542: 
543:       Interval lower = completePartitionsTimeline.floorKey(
544:           new Interval(interval.getStart(), DateTimes.MAX)
545:       );
546: 
547:       if (lower == null || !intervalsOverlap(lower, interval)) {
548:         return finishOvershadowCheck(false);
549:       }
550:       markOvershadowUsedFloor();
551: 
552:       Interval prev = null;
553:       Interval curr = lower;
554: 
555:       do {
556:         if (curr == null ||  //no further keys
557:             (prev != null && curr.getStartMillis() > prev.getEndMillis()) //a discontinuity
558:         ) {
559:           return false;
560:         }
561: 
562:         final TimelineEntry timelineEntry = completePartitionsTimeline.get(curr);
563:         final int versionCompare = versionComparator.compare(version, timelineEntry.getVersion());
564: 
565:         //lower or same version
566:         if (versionCompare > 0) {
567:           return false;
568:         } else if (versionCompare == 0) {
569:           // Intentionally use the Iterators API instead of the stream API for performance.
570:           //noinspection ConstantConditions
571:           final boolean nonOvershadowedObject = Iterators.all(
572:               timelineEntry.partitionHolder.iterator(), chunk -> !chunk.getObject().overshadows(object)
573:           );
574:           if (nonOvershadowedObject) {
575:             return false;
576:           }
577:         }
578: 
579:         prev = curr;
580:         curr = completePartitionsTimeline.higherKey(curr);
581: 
582:       } while (interval.getEndMillis() > prev.getEndMillis());
583: 
584:       return true;
585:     }
586:     finally {
587:       lock.readLock().unlock();
588:     }
589:   }

601:       int compare = versionComparator.compare(entry.getVersion(), existsInTimeline.getVersion());

604:       }

610:     if (lowerKey != null) {
611:       if (addAtKey(timeline, lowerKey, entry)) {
612:         return;
613:       }
614:     }
615: 
616:     Interval higherKey = timeline.higherKey(interval);
617: 
618:     if (higherKey != null) {
619:       if (addAtKey(timeline, higherKey, entry)) {

621:       }
622:     }

624:     addIntervalToTimeline(interval, entry, timeline);

632:       NavigableMap<Interval, TimelineEntry> timeline,
633:       Interval key,
634:       TimelineEntry entry
635:   )

637:     boolean retVal = false;
638:     Interval currKey = key;
639:     Interval entryInterval = entry.getTrueInterval();
640: 
641:     if (!intervalsOverlap(currKey, entryInterval)) {
642:       return false;
643:     }
